title: Record bounded federation durability, refusal and link-failure diagnostics
outcome: The existing diagnostics surface retains bounded metadata for durability transitions, directory/admission refusals and static per-peer terminal/install failures, across later authentication, without changing authority, transport or retry behavior.
acceptance: In the existing diagnostics surface, retain a bounded metadata-only record of each federation_durable false and true transition, including the causing site and the duration it was false, with existing reset-on-restart behavior.
Record the 409 directory and 423 admission refusals with stage and timestamp; do not retain secrets or full payloads, add store tables, retry, or change refusal/hold behavior.

Behavior tests check observable transition/refusal records, bounded retention and restart reset, and that a healthy path stays quiet; focused validation and a fresh review pair have no outstanding Medium or higher before normal integration.

Retain the bounded static terminal metadata and install-failure stage and reason per peer, with timestamp and generation, so the next authenticated attempt doesn't overwrite it. No transport behaviour change.

completion.summary: Bounded federation durability, refusal and link-failure recorder landed on master/origin in combo26 a06f2c92. All four implementation criteria met with linked source, focused Windows validation, no-Medium review pairs and exact-tree Windows/DL560 FULL evidence. Optional diagnostic/test Lows remain separately tracked.
